visualCharacteristics.structure: filter bar (sub-category, year, month, tags, submit) with right-aligned subscribe link, 3-column grid of article cards (image + category label, date, title, tag, '+' link) and numbered pagination, all rendered from the query index

contentPattern.structure: key-value configuration: source index, path prefix, page size, enabled filters, filter UI labels, read-more label, empty/no-results/error messages, optional subscribe link + label
